originality.rationale: Relevant original works count aggregate excedances or prescribed descents, not all joint conditional positional excedance indicators. Comparing implications shows univariate aggregate generating polynomials do not determine the site-indexed pair kernel. Residual risk is an unlocated multivariate excedance-set treatment.
residual_risks: Specialized older enumerators for entire excedance sets of derangements may implicitly contain the two-position formula. An extension of unrestricted-set enumeration with fixed-point exclusion might rederive it.

value.rationale: The complete sitewise covariance kernel gives a universal strict negative dependence signature under derangement conditioning and a Brownian-bridge continuum profile. These are reusable structural data for arbitrary weighted excedance statistics and are stronger than moments of the total count.
